title: polypodium irioides f. cristatum
intro: Polypodium irioides f. cristatum, commonly known as the Crested Polypodium, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Polypodium irioides f. cristatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-edematous, anti-arthritic, and anti-cancer effects.
